# Flip

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Flip:Void vwait:Int32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vwait` | In | Int32 | `1` | 1 waits for the display to be ready before flipping, which avoids tearing. 0 does not wait and may tear. 2 keeps the picture free of tearing but never makes the program wait (see below). Defaults to 1. |

## Description

Shows what was drawn into the back buffer in the window. A program draws a complete picture into the back buffer after `SetBuffer BackBuffer()` and calls Flip once per frame, which keeps the picture free of flicker. The frame rate of the program follows the display when `vwait` is on.

## Differences

* Without a graphics window nothing happens.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local x = 0
While x < 160
	Cls
	Color 255, 160, 0
	Oval x * 2, 100, 40, 40, 1
	Color 255, 255, 255
	Text 10, 10, "Frame " + x
	Flip
	x = x + 4
Wend
```

`Flip 2` is an extension, see [Presentation sync](Presentation-Sync).
